page.layout: One blank cover page with a gold-stamped coat of arms (a lion rampant beside a shield) in the centre. No printed text blocks.
page.notes: Blank vellum or limp binding wrapper, not a printed page. The gold stamp is a tooled armorial emblem on the cover, not text. There is a tiny mark above the emblem that I cannot read. Faint marks and smudges at the left edge look like spine handwriting or stains, so I have not transcribed them. Nothing here counts as printed text.
